meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白质糖基化位点,辅助抗体与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做治疗性抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to support antibody and vaccine design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engineer glycosylation for therapeutic antibodies or vaccines.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能扫描蛋白序列中的 N-糖基化位点(N-X-S/T),预测 O-糖基化热点,并设计突变来添加或去掉糖基化位点;还会引用 NetOGlyc、GlycoShield、GlycoWorkbench 等外部工具做进一步分析。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析或设计糖蛋白、优化治疗性抗体,或设计疫苗抗原时触发。

say.text: 扫描这段蛋白序列的 N-糖基化位点
say.note: Claude 会运行扫描并列出位点位置。

say.text: 预测这条序列的 O-糖基化热点
say.note: 返回候选的 Ser/Thr 残基。

say.text: 把第 100 位的天冬酰胺突变成谷氨酰胺
say.note: Claude 会给出突变后的序列。

howto.what_en: Claude scans protein sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predicts O-glycosylation hotspots, and suggests mutations to add/remove sites. It also points to external tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench) for deeper analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to analyze or engineer glycoproteins, optimize therapeutic antibodies, or design vaccine antigens.

say_en.text: Scan this protein sequence for N-glycosylation sites.
say_en.note: Claude runs the sequon scan and lists positions.

say_en.text: Predict O-glycosylation hotspots in this sequence.
Mutate the asparagine at position 100 to glutamine to remove the glycan site.
